book.name: 2 KOLINITA
book.title: ME KOLINITA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌELUWENA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tuta nina lowa yanuwena ꞌaene geyaꞌabo yayayausimi be yaꞌenaꞌena paꞌalimi be omayamaya yaꞌebwaꞌebwaꞌemi gosemina ꞌina bubuna toꞌumalina manuna. Nate namo ꞌimi leta yaꞌetoladinawa.
ꞌEnega yanuwena ꞌaene ꞌeguma ꞌigu onega yagienuwa mwauyemi, ꞌemiyega yaita ꞌigiegwausowaligu?

Ta ꞌimi leta nina yaꞌetoladinawa ꞌigu ꞌelouya ma igu nuwamwau be ma igu dedoi be ꞌenega tuta ꞌabo yayausimi wada giegwausowaligu, ta geyaꞌabo yanuwanuwa mwau, ta esi maiboꞌami yaemisemi ta yanuwayaina ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu gwausowalega ꞌomi wate wada gwausowala. ꞌEnega ꞌimi leta nina yaꞌetoladinawa, nigeya ꞌaene yagienuwa mwauyemi, ta esi ꞌigu oboboma sinabwa wawasae ꞌemiya wada mwalamwalatoni.
ꞌEbweu tai ꞌina toꞌumalina sida nuwatau
Ta gosemi toꞌumalina nina ꞌigienuwa mwauyegu tupwana namo, ta ꞌomi esi nuwamwau sinabwana ꞌiꞌebwaꞌemi, ta geya nuwagu be yaꞌenapaꞌali,
manuna toꞌumalina ꞌana eꞌisa ꞌilobena maiboꞌami ꞌemiyega, niꞌatu sawesawenaya.
Geyaꞌabo mwau sinabwa wawasae tasaꞌusaꞌu ꞌenaya, ꞌenega ꞌemiya yasida be ꞌina toꞌumalina nina wada nuwatau be wagiegwausowala lima, be wate maꞌemi waegosigosiyana limana.
Gete manuna ꞌimi leta yaꞌetoladinawa be ꞌaene yatoomi, nai loina maiboꞌana waematamatanedi, nai nigeya.
ꞌEguma yaita ꞌina toꞌumalina wanuwatau ꞌaboꞌagu wate yanuwatau, ta toꞌase ꞌaboꞌagu yanuwatauna nate ꞌomi ꞌimi boboꞌana manuna, Keliso matanaya,
ꞌabona nai Seitani ꞌiewaiwai ꞌedaya, manuna ꞌina nuwanuwa toꞌumalina niꞌatu tamwalatonina.
Lowa yatauya Tiloasi, Keliso tetelina sabi loguguyaena ga Yaubada ꞌeda boboꞌana ꞌigigegena, ꞌigu loguguya nina manuna,
ta esi yanuwanuwa sinabwana manuna tasigu Taito nigeya yalobaloba. ꞌEnega me Tiloasi yapilisinedi ga yatauya Masidonia.

ꞌEnega Yaubada ꞌena yalokagutoki, manuna Keliso ꞌina waiwaiyega tuta yauna ꞌigiegie waiwaiyema be ꞌima guinuwao ꞌediya Keliso ꞌana mwalatoi sena maiboꞌana ꞌediya ꞌiꞌelelewana ꞌatuwa senina maina boboꞌana wawasae ꞌiꞌelelewana be tomota simuimui,
nate Keliso ꞌina guinuwa Yaubada ꞌena ga manuna ꞌaloguguyaena, ꞌatuwa senina maina boboꞌana ꞌalelewanena taudi Yaubada ꞌiꞌetoseyedi ꞌediya be taudi wate toesilae ꞌediya.

Taudi toesilae ꞌediya maina nina ꞌana lotoona ꞌatuwa tomwawasa mwauluna, ta saꞌi taudi Yaubada ꞌiꞌetoseyedi maina nina ꞌana lotoona ꞌatuwa yawasi boboꞌana maina nadigega. ꞌEisa tomota sawesawediya guinuwa gete? Nigeya yauna.

Ta ꞌaboꞌama nigeya nadigega tologuguya kabokabodi, taudi ꞌidi esaesa tuga manuna siloguguya, ta esi ꞌaboꞌama ma ꞌama emisa, nadigega Yaubada ꞌiloinema, ꞌenega tauna matanaya Keliso tetelina ꞌaonaona ꞌaiꞌaila.
